회사 소개

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking a Machines FP&A lead to own financial planning for the chips and accelerators that run our models. You will own the hardware forecast and budget, keep leadership's view of machine spend current, and be the single finance point of contact for machines into Accounting and consolidated FP&A.

In this role, you will be a key partner to our capacity planning and hardware teams, and work day to day with the Compute deal team, Accounting, and the consolidated FP&A team.

Key responsibilities

• Own the hardware forecast: delivery volumes, lease and financing expense, and cash flows
• Run budget vs. actuals for machine spend: one view of what the fleet costs and why it moved
• Serve as the single point of contact for machines in forecast and close cycles with Accounting and consolidated FP&A
• Coordinate forecast inputs with Capacity Planning and the Compute deal team
• Track spend and cash-flow phasing against multi-year hardware commitments
• Partner with Accounting on the treatment of leases and related agreements
• Support chip and accelerator economics analyses led by the Machines finance team
• Build the reporting that keeps leadership's machine spend picture current

Minimum qualifications

• Owned a forecast or budget end to end at a hardware, semiconductor, hyperscaler, or infrastructure-heavy business
• Strong driver-based modeling skills and budget-vs-actual / variance discipline
• Comfort partnering closely with engineering and commercial teams under deal-timeline pressure
• Passion for Anthropic's mission to build safe, transformative AI systems

Preferred qualifications

• 7+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, or capacity/infrastructure finance
• Capacity planning or infrastructure FP&A experience at a hyperscaler or major chip maker
• Experience building forecast infrastructure for a new or fast-changing spend area
• Lease and long-term-agreement accounting fluency
• MBA, CFA, or equivalent

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$240,000—$325,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. Overview

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.

With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. Business Segment Overview:

Commercial: With boots on the ground authenticity at the heart of everything we do, our comprehensive array of commercial products and services enable you to work directly with our clients, across hedging, risk management, execution and clearing, OTC products, commodity finance and more.

Position purpose: StoneX Commodity Solutions LLC is part of StoneX Group Inc., a global financial services network that connects clients to markets across commodities, risk management, and physical supply. Our SCS Specialty Coffee team provides green coffee sourcing, sales, trade execution, and risk-management solutions to roasters, importers, and specialty coffee partners.

This is a dual-focus position that blends front-line customer relationship management with behind-the-scenes trade and operations support. The Customer Success Associate / Trade Assistant is the connective tissue of the desk — keeping customers informed and supported while ensuring trades, contracts, and logistics run smoothly from execution through delivery. It is an ideal opportunity for an organized, detail-oriented professional who wants exposure to both the commercial and operational sides of the specialty coffee trade.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, SCS Specialty Coffee, this role serves as a primary day-to-day contact for customers and as a core support resource for the sales and trading team. On the customer success side, you will own the post-sale relationship — onboarding accounts, coordinating samples, communicating order and shipment status, and resolving issues. On the trade-assistant side, you will support contract administration, position tracking, logistics coordination, and trade documentation. Success in this role means customers feel well cared for and the desk’s trades and records are accurate, timely, and audit-ready.

Note on role design: This role is currently structured as a single, combined position covering both customer success and trade-assistant responsibilities (approximately a 50/50 split). As the desk grows, the intent is to split it into two specialized roles. The successful candidate will help shape and document both functions in the interim.

Responsibilities

Primary duties will include:

Customer Success

• Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned specialty green coffee customers.
• Onboard new accounts and maintain accurate, up-to-date customer records in the CRM.
• Coordinate coffee sample requests end to end — dispatch, tracking, and follow-up on approvals.
• Proactively communicate order status, contract milestones, delivery timelines, and relevant market updates to customers.
• Respond to customer inquiries promptly, resolve issues, and escalate complex matters to the appropriate sales executive or trader.
• Support customer retention and, in partnership with the sales team, identify opportunities to grow existing accounts.
• Gather customer feedback and share insights with sales and trading to improve service and offerings.

Trade Assistant

• Support traders and sales executives with trade execution, contract administration, and day-to-day desk operations.
• Draft, issue, and track purchase and sales contracts, verifying that terms, quantities, prices, and differentials are accurate.
• Maintain position records, reconcile them against executed trades, and support weekly position reporting.
• Coordinate logistics with operations — shipment bookings, shipping documents, inventory, and warehouse tracking.
• Liaise with operations, finance, and settlements on invoicing, payments, and trade documentation.
• Monitor contract execution milestones such as shipment, first-notice/quality steps, grading, and arrival.
• Assist with futures and hedging administration and reconciliation under the supervision of the trading team.
• Maintain data integrity across trading, CRM, and reporting systems.

Shared / General

• Partner across sales, trading, operations, and finance to keep information flowing and deadlines met.
• Help build and document repeatable processes as the desk scales and the role prepares to split into two functions.
• Prepare reports, trackers, and dashboards to support the team and leadership.

Qualifications

To land this role you will need:

• 1–3 years of experience in a customer-facing, operations, administrative, or coordination role — relevant internship experience will also be considered.
• Strong organizational skills and a high level of attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the broader Microsoft Office suite, and the ability to quickly learn CRM and trade/ERP systems.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a genuine customer-service orientation.
• Ability to work onsite at the Alpharetta, GA office and legal authorization to work in the United States.

What makes you stand out:

• Prior experience in coffee, green coffee, or a related soft-commodities, commodity-trading, import, or logistics environment (preferred, not required).
• Direct experience with green coffee contracts, ICE Coffee “C” futures, or physical commodity trade operations.
• Familiarity with trade documentation — contracts, bills of lading, phytosanitary and origin certificates, and warehouse receipts.
• Experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics) and trade/position-management systems.
• Working knowledge of the specialty coffee supply chain, coffee origins, grading, and quality evaluation.
• Additional language skills (e.g., Spanish or Portuguese) are a plus given origin and supplier relationships.

Education / Certification Requirement:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, agribusiness, economics, finance, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

Working Style:

• 4 days per week onsite, 1 day per week remote

Skills & Competencies

• Detail-oriented and process-driven — accurate with numbers, documents, and records.
• Relationship-focused — builds trust with customers and internal partners alike.
• Analytical and numerate — comfortable working with pricing, positions, and reporting data.
• Adaptable — thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven trading environment.
• Proactive and accountable — takes ownership and follows through without being prompted.
• Problem solver — proactively identifies issues and develops practical solutions.
• Team-oriented — collaborates well across sales, trading, and operations.
